999008199.text: ……はっ！？　ここは……
ここが、本の中の世界……！？

localizations.en: This is... the world inside the book?!

999008199.text: 確かに、普段の景色とは雰囲気が違うわね

localizations.en: It definitely has a different atmosphere from our usual scenery.

999008199.text:
あれ、お城じゃない……
もしかしてお姫様はいないのかな

localizations.en: Huh, it's not a castle... I wonder if there's a princess here after all.

999008199.text: 気にするとこ、そこなの？

localizations.en: Is that really what you're concerned about right now?

999008199.text: わあ……わあ……！
レスナ、すごい楽しそう。まあ何よりだけどさ

localizations.en: Resna looks like she's having a blast. Well, that's good I guess.

999008199.text:
子どもの頃、本の世界に入ってみたいなーって
思ったりすることがあって……

localizations.en: When I was little, I used to think about how amazing it would be to enter the world of a book...

999008199.text:
わぁ。とっても素敵な夢だね！
えっと、レスナちゃんはどんな本が……

localizations.en: That sounds wonderful! What kind of books did you...

999008199.text:
はぁ、はぁ……こんな形で夢が叶うなんて！
あっちのほうはどうなっているんだろう！！

localizations.en: Hah, hah... To think my dream would come true like this! I wonder what's over there?!

999008199.text: あっ、レスナちゃん！？
レスナ、大丈夫かしら

localizations.en: Is Resna going to be all right?

999008199.text: 見回した感じ、危険はなさそうだけど……

localizations.en: I don't sense any danger, but it pays to be cautious...

999008199.text:
あはは。憧れてた世界に来たんだもん。
気持ちは分かるなぁ

localizations.en: Well, her dreams came true... I can understand how she feels.

999008199.text:
そうね。色んなことを体験してきたけど、
本の中っていうのは初めてだもの

localizations.en: Well said. We've experienced all sorts of things, but being inside a book is a first.

999008199.text:
そうだね。ここの物質って現実と同じなのか
気になるし……素材にしたらどうなるんだろう？

localizations.en: Right. I'm curious whether the materials here are the same as in reality... What would happen if we used them for synthesis?

999008199.text:
わぁ、トトリちゃん現実的だ！
でも確かにそのへんのもの、気になるなぁ

localizations.en: Ahh, Totori, you're way too focused on work! But I'm definitely curious about the stuff around here too.

999008199.text: ですよね？　たとえばあそこの植物なんですけど……

localizations.en: I know, right? For example, those plants over there...

999008199.text:
あっ、錬金術の話だね！
聞いた話だと、本の世界の素材ってねー

localizations.en: Oh, alchemy talk! From what I've heard, materials from book worlds are...

999008199.text: ったく、緊張感ないわね

localizations.en: Geez, you guys have no sense of urgency.

999008199.text: あはは、つい。気を引き締めないとだね

localizations.en: Ahaha, we got carried away. We need to stay focused.

999008199.text: ん？　これは……
きゃあぁぁぁぁ～～～！！
